Financials Price-to-Book Valuation Spreads
Financials’ performance may be durable this time  
Investors considering financials may be concerned about a repeat of 2016, when the sector underperformed despite low 
valuations and improving earnings. This time it looks different. The sector’s valuation spreads are near recessionary levels 
(left), suggesting the market is priced for bad news. Interest rates and credit spreads have declined— a good combination for 
the sector, historically (right).
